numeric.name: driver_age
numeric.description: Age of the primary driver in years; a fundamental risk factor capturing young/inexperienced and elderly driver risk profiles.

numeric.name: vehicle_age
numeric.description: Age of the insured vehicle in years; older vehicles typically have lower values but higher mechanical failure risk and different repair cost profiles.
numeric.data_quality_note: Max of 68 years is plausible for classic/vintage vehicles but worth validating against vehicle_value for consistency.

numeric.name: age_driving_licence
numeric.description: Number of years the driver has held a licence; proxy for driving experience, correlated with but distinct from driver_age.
numeric.data_quality_note: Min of 0 may indicate newly licensed drivers; values should be cross-checked against driver_age for logical consistency (licence age cannot exceed driver_age minus ~16).

numeric.name: vehicle_value
numeric.description: Market or insured value of the vehicle in currency units; key driver of comprehensive/property damage premium and theft exposure.
numeric.data_quality_note: 0.14% nulls require imputation; max of ~374k suggests high-value/exotic vehicles — consider capping or log-transforming to reduce leverage.

numeric.name: power_to_weight_ratio
numeric.description: Engine power relative to vehicle weight; proxy for vehicle performance and associated accident severity/frequency risk.
numeric.data_quality_note: Min of 0 may indicate missing or electric vehicles with no combustion engine — verify these records.

numeric.name: seats
numeric.description: Number of seats in the vehicle; relates to occupant exposure and vehicle category (passenger car vs. minibus).
numeric.data_quality_note: Low cardinality (8 unique values); could be treated as categorical but numeric encoding is appropriate for GBM.

numeric.name: theft_premium
numeric.description: Current booked theft premium component; reflects theft risk pricing already embedded in the tariff.
numeric.data_quality_note: Min of 0 expected for policies without theft cover.

categorical.name: policy_type
categorical.description: Type of motor insurance policy (e.g., comprehensive, third-party); directly determines which coverages are included and is a primary risk/premium driver.
categorical.data_quality_note: Ordering is approximate from least to most comprehensive coverage; CC vs COMP_N/COMP_E ordering should be validated against actual coverage definitions.

categorical.name: business_type
categorical.description: Indicates whether the policy is new business (NB) or a renewal/portfolio transfer (P); renewal business typically has lower risk due to selection effects.

categorical.name: payment_frequency
categorical.description: Frequency of premium payment (Annual, Semi-annual, Quarterly); more frequent payment may correlate with financial stress and higher lapse/risk profiles.

categorical.name: bonus_score
categorical.description: Bonus-malus or no-claims discount score (Good, Neutral, Bad); direct indicator of historical claims experience and future risk.
categorical.data_quality_note: Highly imbalanced — 'B' and 'N' categories are small; ensure sufficient credibility for model learning.

categorical.name: fuel_type
categorical.description: Type of fuel used by the vehicle (Diesel, Gasoline); associated with vehicle usage patterns, engine type, and repair cost differences.
categorical.data_quality_note: 0.36% nulls require imputation or a missing indicator; consider whether missing fuel type correlates with electric/hybrid vehicles.

categorical.name: vehicle_brand
categorical.description: Manufacturer/brand of the insured vehicle; captures brand-level differences in repair costs, theft attractiveness, and driver demographics.
categorical.data_quality_note: 68 unique brands with varying exposure volumes; low-frequency brands may need grouping to avoid overfitting.

categorical.name: municipality_type
categorical.description: Classification of the municipality where the vehicle is registered (e.g., Interior, Capital, Island); proxy for traffic density and accident/theft risk.

categorical.name: circulation_area
categorical.description: Urban or rural circulation area of the vehicle; urban areas typically exhibit higher frequency of minor accidents and theft.
